headline: The factory can no longer sign Jon's name: bot comments can't answer Jon's questions
lede: A builder status line once read as Jon's ruling and auto-closed his question. The sweep now recognizes every shape the factory writes — claimed, checkpoint, yielding, and the sneaky comma form — so only prose that isn't bookkeeping counts as a decision.

notes.text: #1418 shipped (#1454): one exhaustive regex replaces the bot-prefix list in jonq — slot-suffixed comments like 'FORGE (a): claimed …' and 'FORGE (b), rule-4 …' can never parse as Jon's reply again; the sweep also re-asserts content-provenance at the close site.

Author equality is not provenance: gh authenticates as jalfern for the factory too, so the ONLY defense is the comment's content shape. 15 new jonqcheck fixtures pin every bot grammar plus the exact #1403 victim event (it now times out to its default instead of false-closing ANSWERED).
A stale worktree registration was holding `main` and made the rule-5 merge exit 1 AFTER merging — merge landed anyway as 3264c5e. Lanes: `git worktree prune` before step 7.
QA: the demo feedback panel no longer swallows a tap on the note box (#1453) — you can type without the panel vanishing mid-click.
